74103 A person is entitled to SP payable at the full rate if they


1. have reached pensionable age and


2. have 35 or more qualifying years1.


Note 1: See DMG 74022 for the meaning of pensionable age and DMG 74023 for the meaning of
qualifying year.


Note 2: See DMG 74012 for guidance on references to HMRC if there is a dispute about a NI contribution
